2) Product/Bench: SLA and latency band required for each (Laura).
3) Ops: earliest provisioning lead times and whether burst credits can be used as temporary buffer (Marissa).
4) Finance: any gating on billing structure or invoicing cadence that would change the commitment threshold (cc'ing finance via Ben).

I've attached a first-pass workbook (reserve_scenarios_v3.xlsx) with three allocation profiles (conservative / target / aggressive) and a simple cost delta model. Please add your inputs directly in the sheet titled "Week-2025-05-12".

- Flag any deals that require private deployment (will change hardware region and SLA constraints).

I'll consolidate by EOD and share a one-pager for the finance forecast.
